fix: cron 2026-11-13: rebuilt from the audited FY2025 statement. Three defects removed. (1) The investing total was -9,878m because the disposal of subsidiary, net of cash disposed of, -16,666m had been dropped; the audited statement prints -26,544m. (2) Financing was 13,837m because dividends paid of -17,674m had been dropped; the audited statement prints -3,837m. (3) The Net Change in Cash row held a cash BALANCE (478,469m and then the closing balances 299,284m, 459,637m, 213,288m and 58,029m) instead of the year's change. The change is now stored, and for the three earlier columns it is computed and cross-checked two ways: operating plus investing plus financing plus the translation effect equals closing less opening cash (FY2023 247,564m, FY2022 155,259m, FY2021 -7,145m).
